skill.name: frontend-design

skill.author: anthropics

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces can make useful products feel unfinished or forgettable. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished frontend work with a clear visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of a clear aesthetic direction before implementation.
Encourages working HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue interfaces.
Provides guidance for typography, color, motion, layout, and visual details.
Pushes designs away from common AI-generated visual patterns.
Helps match implementation complexity to the chosen interface style.

Does not test accessibility, responsiveness, or performance by itself.
Does not provide brand assets, fonts, icons, or images.
Requires the user to provide product goals, audience, and technical constraints.

use_cases.title: Create a Product Dashboard
use_cases.description: Build a memorable dashboard with deliberate layout, type, color, and interaction choices.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Marketing Page
use_cases.description: Turn a campaign concept into a polished page that avoids generic template styling.

use_cases.title: Improve an App Screen
use_cases.description: Rework an existing screen so the interface feels cohesive, refined, and context specific.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Simple Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single interface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a landing page for [product]. Audience: [audience]. Tech stack: [stack]. Make it polished and distinctive.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused request for one reusable UI element.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a [component] for [context]. Include responsive states, hover behavior, and a clear aesthetic direction.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an Existing Screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using current UI problems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to redesign this screen: [screen description]. Preserve the workflow, improve visual hierarchy, and avoid generic AI styling.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Full Interface System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete product surface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a cohesive interface for [product]. Define the visual direction, key states, layout system, motion, and implementation details.

output_examples.input: Build a signup page for an independent music analytics tool.
output_examples.output: A working signup page with a music-focused visual direction, distinctive typography, responsive layout, animated call-to-action states, and refined form styling.

output_examples.input: Redesign a project management dashboard for studio teams.
output: A dense but readable dashboard layout for repeated daily use.
A cohesive palette, typography system, and motion approach.
Clear task, timeline, and status areas with usable interaction states.

output_examples.input: Create a hero section for a boutique hotel website.
output_examples.output: A first-screen experience that signals the hotel identity immediately, uses strong imagery, and keeps the next section visible on common viewports.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product goal, brand context, and technical stack before asking for implementation.
Ask for responsive behavior, interaction states, and accessibility considerations in the same request.
Review the generated interface in a browser and request refinements based on real screenshots.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a beautiful page without explaining the product, audience, or use case.
Do not accept generic gradients, centered cards, or common font choices when the context needs stronger identity.
Do not skip testing layout, text wrapping, and interaction states across desktop and mobile viewports.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create frontend pages, components, and application screens with a clear visual direction.

faq.question: Does it generate working code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the model to implement working frontend code in common web technologies.

faq.question: Can it work with React or Vue?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill mentions HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend options.

faq.question: Does it replace a design system?
faq.answer: No. It guides interface creation, but it does not supply a complete reusable design system.

faq.question: Is this only for landing pages?
faq.answer: No. It can guide components, pages, applications, dashboards, and other frontend interfaces.

faq.question: What input improves the results?
faq.answer: The best input includes audience, purpose, technical constraints, brand tone, and required user flows.
